verdict.rationale: Agent creation is API-driven: Reusable Agent Configurations persist the agent block through the API and return a UUID. A built-in MCP server in the dg CLI gives coding agents direct access to Deepgram APIs, and an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt are published. Telephony, however, is documented only as a Twilio bridge your own server runs: the number is dialed through Twilio and audio is relayed to the WebSocket. There is no Deepgram API, CLI or MCP operation for attaching a number or placing an outbound call. Missing for 10: first-party number provisioning/attachment via API/CLI/MCP, a programmatic outbound call-placement endpoint, evidence that the CLI/MCP exposes voice-agent provisioning (the CLI is described only for transcription, TTS, analysis and account management), and hands-on corroboration of a dashboard-free end-to-end flow.
